comment: Tweak catalog. kind: Registry | Appx | ProvisionedAppx | Service | ScheduledTask | StorePolicy. For Registry, scope is CurrentUser or LocalMachine and path is relative to HKCU\ or HKLM\. For Service, target is the service Name. For ScheduledTask, taskPath + taskName identify it. For StorePolicy, target is a comma separated list of Package Family Names that Windows 11 25H2 should stop provisioning for new profiles.

tweaks.title: Turn off the Advertising ID
tweaks.description: Stops apps using your per-user advertising identifier for targeted ads.

tweaks.title: Block the Advertising ID by policy
tweaks.description: Machine-wide enforcement of the above, so apps cannot re-enable it.

tweaks.title: Turn off tailored experiences
tweaks.description: Stops Microsoft using diagnostics to personalise tips, ads and recommendations.

tweaks.title: Diagnostic data to minimum
tweaks.description: Sends required data only instead of optional usage data.

tweaks.title: Cap diagnostic data ceiling
tweaks.description: Prevents the diagnostic level being raised above the minimum.

tweaks.title: Turn off activity history
tweaks.description: Stops recording your recent apps and browsing in the activity feed.

tweaks.title: Turn off activity upload
tweaks.description: Stops sending activity data between your devices.

tweaks.title: Stop tracking app launches for Start
tweaks.description: Stops Start and search improving themselves by watching what you launch.

tweaks.title: Edge diagnostic data off
tweaks.description: Stops Edge sending optional browser diagnostics.

tweaks.title: Edge personalisation off
tweaks.description: Stops Edge sending browsing history to personalise ads and news.

tweaks.title: Microsoft 365 online content off
tweaks.description: Stops the Office apps fetching web fonts and dynamic content that phone home.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows location services
tweaks.description: Disables the location service used by Maps, Weather and Find My Device.

tweaks.title: Turn off Find My Device
tweaks.description: Stops the device location feed used to locate lost machines.

tweaks.title: Silence feedback frequency popups
tweaks.description: Stops the 'how is Windows working for you?' nags.

tweaks.title: Block silent app installs
tweaks.description: Stops Windows quietly installing suggested apps on the image.

tweaks.title: Turn off tips and suggestions
tweaks.description: Removes the 'Tips for you' and suggestion surfaces in Windows.

tweaks.title: Stop silently installing suggested apps
tweaks.description: Prevents suggested apps being installed without you asking.

tweaks.title: Turn off lock screen spotlight
tweaks.description: Stops rotating Bing images and tips on the lock screen.

tweaks.title: Unlock screen suggestions
tweaks.description: Disables the 'suggested content' slot on the lock screen.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows tips
tweaks.description: Disables the 'Tips' slot in Start and notifications.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows Spotlight
tweaks.description: Stops Spotlight images and the related prompts on the lock screen.

tweaks.title: Turn off Copilot for this user
tweaks.description: Applies the Copilot off policy to your account.

tweaks.title: Turn off Copilot machine-wide
tweaks.description: Applies the Copilot off policy to every account on this PC.

tweaks.title: Turn off Cortana
tweaks.description: Disables the assistant and its search integration.

tweaks.title: Turn off web search in the search box
tweaks.description: Keeps Start and Search local instead of querying Bing.

tweaks.title: Unlink Bing web results
tweaks.description: Stops search results being sourced from the web.

tweaks.title: Turn off search box suggestions
tweaks.description: Stops typing in the search box sending anything to Microsoft.

tweaks.title: Turn off search history suggestions
tweaks.description: Stops previously typed searches being suggested.

tweaks.title: Disable Connected User Experiences and Telemetry
tweaks.description: The main telemetry collector service.

tweaks.title: Disable Diagnostic Policy Service
tweaks.description: Sends diagnostic and inventory data to Microsoft.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops crash reports being sent. You lose 'Report a problem' diagnostics.

tweaks.title: Disable Maps download service
tweaks.description: Stops offline map tiles downloading in the background.

tweaks.title: Disable Location Management
tweaks.description: Location lookup service, only useful if you use location apps.

tweaks.title: Disable Compatibility Appraiser
tweaks.description: Scans your software inventory to improve compatibility databases.

tweaks.title: Disable ProgramDataUpdater
tweaks.description: Pushes application usage data to Microsoft.

tweaks.title: Disable Customer Experience Program consolidator
tweaks.description: The legacy CEIP telemetry consolidator task.

tweaks.title: Disable CEIP USB survey
tweaks.description: The 'Which USB devices do you use?' survey.

tweaks.title: Disable Autochk proxy
tweaks.description: Legacy maintenance proxy task.

tweaks.title: Disable Feedback Hub data collector
tweaks.description: Collects telemetry for feedback submissions.

tweaks.title: Disable Feedback Hub scenario download
tweaks.description: Downloads feedback survey scenarios.

tweaks.title: Disable advertising debug task
tweaks.description: Advertising measurement task used to test ad targeting.

tweaks.title: Disable CloudExperienceHost consolidation
tweaks.description: The sign-in and first-run cloud setup task.

tweaks.title: Disable Maps update task
tweaks.description: Periodic offline map downloads.

tweaks.title: Disable Maps toast task
tweaks.description: Promotional toasts for Maps.

tweaks.title: Dark mode for apps
tweaks.description: Switches app windows to the dark theme.

tweaks.title: Dark mode for Windows
tweaks.description: Switches the shell, taskbar and Settings to dark.

tweaks.title: Turn off transparency effects
tweaks.description: Solid window backgrounds instead of acrylic blur. Looks cleaner and renders faster.

tweaks.title: Always show file extensions
tweaks.description: Shows .exe, .txt and friends in Explorer so files are not disguised.

tweaks.title: Open Explorer to This PC
tweaks.description: Skips the Home / Quick access page when opening a folder.

tweaks.title: Remove the widgets button
tweaks.description: Removes the weather and news widget from the taskbar.

tweaks.title: Remove the Task View button
tweaks.description: Removes the virtual desktop button from the taskbar.

tweaks.title: Search box as an icon only
tweaks.description: Collapses the taskbar search box to just the magnifier.

tweaks.title: Hide Start menu recommendations
tweaks.description: Hides the Recommended section and promoted content in Start.

tweaks.title: Turn off Start menu sync notifications
tweaks.description: Hides the 'just installed / recently updated' toast in Start.

tweaks.title: Always combine taskbar buttons
tweaks.description: Shows taskbar icons as a single stacked group rather than separate buttons.

tweaks.title: Disable Peek at full desktop preview
tweaks.description: Stops hovering a taskbar group from dimming the desktop.

tweaks.title: Stop these apps being provisioned for new users
tweaks.description: Windows 11 25H2 deprovision policy. Stops the listed apps being re-installed into new or reset profiles, so removals survive a feature update. Does not affect the current profile.
